name: Eric Schmitt

issue_poll.name: Emerson College/The Hill Missouri poll, Sept 23–27, 2022; Pew Research Center national survey, Oct 10–16, 2022
issue_poll.note: Ranks 1–5 from Emerson's Missouri most-important-issue question (only five issues published). Ranks 6–10 filled from Pew's national 'very important' list (https://www.pewresearch.org/wp-content/uploads/sites/20/2022/10/PP_2022.10.20_midterms-economy_REPORT.pdf), skipping items already ranked. 'Threats to democracy' mapped to Elections / voting.

issues.position: Stop spending increases; pass a balanced budget amendment

votes.question: On the motion to concur in the House amendment

issues.note: Balanced budget amendment pledge (https://www.semissourian.com/news/state-ag-pledges-to-be-fighter-if-elected-senator-2950422) got no floor vote.

issues.position: Oppose Democratic bills federalizing election rules
issues.note: No floor vote on Democratic federal election bills this term.

issues.position: Leave abortion to the states; supported overturning Roe

votes.question: Cloture on the motion to proceed

issues.position: Take on big insurance and drug companies (no specific policy)
Finish the border wall; keep Title 42; Remain in Mexico
Oppose defunding police; back law enforcement
Oppose the Inflation Reduction Act's climate provisions
issues.note: H.R.1 repealed or phased out many IRA clean-energy credits.

issues.position: Defend the Second Amendment (no specific policy)
Listed Supreme Court justices as a priority, no detail

caveats: Missouri poll published only five issues; ranks 6–10 come from national Pew polling.
Schmitt skipped the debate and candidate questionnaires, so few specific campaign positions exist; five issues are not testable.
Yea votes on H.R.1 (roll 372) and H.R.4 (roll 411) inferred from party-line tallies (only named Republican defectors voted Nay); not seen on a roll list.
2026 SAVE America Act votes (a Republican federal election rule) were not counted against his pledge to oppose Democratic federalization bills; his votes on it were not checked.
